dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Entschuldigung, wo finde ich das Brot?
dialogue.translation: Excuse me, where can I find the bread?
dialogue.translation_en: Excuse me, where can I find the bread?
dialogue.translation_id: Permisi, di mana saya bisa menemukan roti?

dialogue.speaker: cashier
dialogue.text: Das Brot ist in der Abteilung drei, links.
dialogue.translation: The bread is in section three, on the left.
dialogue.translation_en: The bread is in section three, on the left.
dialogue.translation_id: Rotinya ada di bagian tiga, sebelah kiri.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Vielen Dank! Und was kostet die Milch?
dialogue.translation: Thank you very much! And how much does the milk cost?
dialogue.translation_en: Thank you very much! And how much does the milk cost?
dialogue.translation_id: Terima kasih banyak! Berapa harga susunya?

dialogue.speaker: cashier
dialogue.text: Ein Liter Milch kostet einen Euro zwanzig.
dialogue.translation: One liter of milk costs one euro twenty.
dialogue.translation_en: One liter of milk costs one euro twenty.
dialogue.translation_id: Satu liter susu harganya satu euro dua puluh.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Ich nehme zwei Liter, bitte. Ich möchte zahlen.
dialogue.translation: I'll take two liters, please. I'd like to pay.
dialogue.translation_en: I'll take two liters, please. I'd like to pay.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya ambil dua liter, tolong. Saya mau bayar.

dialogue.speaker: cashier
dialogue.text: Das macht zusammen zwölf Euro. Karte oder bar?
dialogue.translation: That comes to twelve euros in total. Card or cash?
dialogue.translation_en: That comes to twelve euros in total. Card or cash?
dialogue.translation_id: Total dua belas euro. Kartu atau tunai?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Mit Karte, bitte. Hier ist meine Quittung, danke.
dialogue.translation: With card, please. Here is my receipt, thanks.
dialogue.translation_en: With card, please. Here is my receipt, thanks.
dialogue.translation_id: Pakai kartu, tolong. Ini struk saya, terima kasih.

title: Auf dem Bahnhof (At the Train Station)

dialogue.speaker: passenger
dialogue.text: Guten Tag! Ich möchte ein Ticket nach Berlin, bitte.
dialogue.translation: Good day! I'd like a ticket to Berlin, please.
dialogue.translation_en: Good day! I'd like a ticket to Berlin, please.
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat siang! Saya mau tiket ke Berlin, tolong.

dialogue.speaker: employee
dialogue.text: Gern. Einfach oder hin und zurück?
dialogue.translation: Sure. One-way or round trip?
dialogue.translation_en: Sure. One-way or round trip?
dialogue.translation_id: Tentu. Sekali jalan atau pulang-pergi?

dialogue.speaker: passenger
dialogue.text: Hin und zurück, bitte. Wann fährt der nächste Zug?
dialogue.translation: Round trip, please. When does the next train leave?
dialogue.translation_en: Round trip, please. When does the next train leave?
dialogue.translation_id: Pulang-pergi, tolong. Kapan kereta berikutnya berangkat?

dialogue.speaker: employee
dialogue.text: Um dreizehn Uhr fünfzehn von Bahnsteig vier.
dialogue.translation: At 1:15 pm from platform four.
dialogue.translation_en: At 1:15 pm from platform four.
dialogue.translation_id: Jam 13.15 dari peron empat.

dialogue.speaker: passenger
dialogue.text: Wie lange dauert die Fahrt?
dialogue.translation: How long does the trip take?
dialogue.translation_en: How long does the trip take?
dialogue.translation_id: Berapa lama perjalanannya?

dialogue.speaker: employee
dialogue.text: Ungefähr vier Stunden. Ich wünsche Ihnen eine gute Reise!
dialogue.translation: About four hours. I wish you a good trip!
dialogue.translation_en: About four hours. I wish you a good trip!
dialogue.translation_id: Sekitar empat jam. Selamat menempuh perjalanan!

dialogue.speaker: mieter
dialogue.text: Guten Tag, ich rufe wegen der Wohnung an.
dialogue.translation: Good day, I'm calling about the apartment.
dialogue.translation_en: Good day, I'm calling about the apartment.
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat siang, saya menelepon soal apartemennya.

dialogue.speaker: vermieter
dialogue.text: Ja, gern. Wie viel kostet sie?
dialogue.translation: Yes, sure. How much does it cost?
dialogue.translation_en: Yes, sure. How much does it cost?
dialogue.translation_id: Ya, silakan. Berapa biayanya?

dialogue.speaker: mieter
dialogue.text: Sie hat zwei Zimmer, eine Küche und ein Badezimmer.
dialogue.translation: It has two rooms, a kitchen and a bathroom.
dialogue.translation_en: It has two rooms, a kitchen and a bathroom.
dialogue.translation_id: Apartemennya punya dua kamar, dapur, dan kamar mandi.

dialogue.speaker: vermieter
dialogue.text: Die Miete ist achthundert Euro warm.
dialogue.translation: The rent is eight hundred euros including utilities.
dialogue.translation_en: The rent is eight hundred euros including utilities.
dialogue.translation_id: Sewanya delapan ratus euro termasuk utilitas.

dialogue.speaker: mieter
dialogue.text: Das ist etwas teuer. Gibt es einen Rabatt?
dialogue.translation: That is a bit expensive. Is there a discount?
dialogue.translation_en: That is a bit expensive. Is there a discount?
dialogue.translation_id: Itu agak mahal. Apakah ada diskon?

dialogue.speaker: vermieter
dialogue.text: Leider nicht. Aber Sie können die Wohnung am Samstag besichtigen.
dialogue.translation: Unfortunately not. But you can view the apartment on Saturday.
dialogue.translation_en: Unfortunately not. But you can view the apartment on Saturday.
dialogue.translation_id: Sayangnya tidak. Tapi Anda bisa melihat apartemennya hari Sabtu.

dialogue.speaker: kellner
dialogue.text: Guten Abend! Was darf ich Ihnen bringen?
dialogue.translation: Good evening! What may I bring you?
dialogue.translation_en: Good evening! What may I bring you?
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat malam! Ada yang bisa saya bawakan?

dialogue.speaker: gast
dialogue.text: Ich hätte gern die Suppe und dann den Fisch.
dialogue.translation: I'd like the soup and then the fish.
dialogue.translation_en: I'd like the soup and then the fish.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya mau sup dulu, lalu ikan.

dialogue.speaker: kellner
dialogue.text: Sehr gern. Möchten Sie etwas zu trinken?
dialogue.translation: Very well. Would you like something to drink?
dialogue.translation_en: Very well. Would you like something to drink?
dialogue.translation_id: Baik. Mau minum apa?

dialogue.speaker: gast
dialogue.text: Ja, eine Flasche Wasser, bitte. Die Speisekarte, bitte.
dialogue.translation: Yes, a bottle of water, please. The menu, please.
dialogue.translation_en: Yes, a bottle of water, please. The menu, please.
dialogue.translation_id: Ya, satu botol air, tolong. Menu makanannya, tolong.

dialogue.speaker: kellner
dialogue.text: Das Essen schmeckt gut, oder?
dialogue.translation: The food tastes good, doesn't it?
dialogue.translation_en: The food tastes good, doesn't it?
dialogue.translation_id: Makanannya enak, kan?

dialogue.speaker: gast
dialogue.text: Ja, sehr lecker! Ich hätte gern die Rechnung, bitte.
dialogue.translation: Yes, very delicious! I'd like the bill, please.
dialogue.translation_en: Yes, very delicious! I'd like the bill, please.
dialogue.translation_id: Ya, sangat lezat! Saya minta tagihannya, tolong.

dialogue.speaker: kellner
dialogue.text: Zusammen oder getrennt?
dialogue.translation: Together or separately?
dialogue.translation_en: Together or separately?
dialogue.translation_id: Bayarnya bersamaan atau terpisah?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: Hallo Anna! Was machst du am Wochenende?
dialogue.translation: Hi Anna! What are you doing this weekend?
dialogue.translation_en: Hi Anna! What are you doing this weekend?
dialogue.translation_id: Hai Anna! Apa yang kamu lakukan akhir pekan?

dialogue.speaker: anna
dialogue.text: Am Samstag gehe ich mit meiner Familie in den Zoo.
dialogue.translation: On Saturday I'm going to the zoo with my family.
dialogue.translation_en: On Saturday I'm going to the zoo with my family.
dialogue.translation_id: Hari Sabtu saya pergi ke kebun binatang bersama keluarga.

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: Das klingt schön! Und am Sonntag?
dialogue.translation: That sounds nice! And on Sunday?
dialogue.translation_en: That sounds nice! And on Sunday?
dialogue.translation_id: Kedengarannya menyenangkan! Kalau hari Minggu?

dialogue.speaker: anna
dialogue.text: Am Sonntag mache ich vielleicht eine Radtour.
dialogue.translation: On Sunday I might go on a bike tour.
dialogue.translation_en: On Sunday I might go on a bike tour.
dialogue.translation_id: Hari Minggu mungkin saya bersepeda.

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: Wollen wir zusammen fahren? Ich kenne eine schöne Strecke.
dialogue.translation: Shall we ride together? I know a nice route.
dialogue.translation_en: Shall we ride together? I know a nice route.
dialogue.translation_id: Maukah kita bersepeda bareng? Saya tahu rute yang bagus.

dialogue.speaker: anna
dialogue.text: Gerne! Wann treffen wir uns?
dialogue.translation: Gladly! When shall we meet?
dialogue.translation_en: Gladly! When shall we meet?
dialogue.translation_id: Tentu! Kapan kita bertemu?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: Um neun Uhr vor dem Park, wenn das Wetter gut ist.
dialogue.translation: At nine in front of the park, if the weather is good.
dialogue.translation_en: At nine in front of the park, if the weather is good.
dialogue.translation_id: Jam sembilan di depan taman, kalau cuacanya bagus.

dialogue.speaker: arzt
dialogue.text: Guten Morgen! Was kann ich für Sie tun?
dialogue.translation: Good morning! What can I do for you?
dialogue.translation_en: Good morning! What can I do for you?
dialogue.translation_id: Selamat pagi! Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Ich fühle mich seit zwei Tagen schlecht und habe Halsschmerzen.
dialogue.translation: I've been feeling bad for two days and have a sore throat.
dialogue.translation_en: I've been feeling bad for two days and have a sore throat.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya merasa tidak enak badan sejak dua hari dan tenggorokan sakit.

dialogue.speaker: arzt
dialogue.text: Haben Sie auch Fieber?
dialogue.translation: Do you also have a fever?
dialogue.translation_en: Do you also have a fever?
dialogue.translation_id: Apakah kamu juga demam?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Ja, gestern Abend hatte ich achtunddreißig Grad.
dialogue.translation: Yes, last night I had 38 degrees.
dialogue.translation_en: Yes, last night I had 38 degrees.
dialogue.translation_id: Ya, semalam suhu saya 38 derajat.

dialogue.speaker: arzt
dialogue.text: Öffnen Sie bitte den Mund. Ich verschreibe Ihnen Tabletten und Tee.
dialogue.translation: Please open your mouth. I'll prescribe you tablets and tea.
dialogue.translation_en: Please open your mouth. I'll prescribe you tablets and tea.
dialogue.translation_id: Tolong buka mulut Anda. Saya meresepkan obat tablet dan teh.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Wie oft muss ich die Tabletten nehmen?
dialogue.translation: How often do I have to take the tablets?
dialogue.translation_en: How often do I have to take the tablets?
dialogue.translation_id: Berapa kali saya harus minum tabletnya?

dialogue.speaker: arzt
dialogue.text: Dreimal täglich nach dem Essen. Bleiben Sie zu Hause und ruhen Sie sich aus.
dialogue.translation: Three times a day after meals. Stay home and rest.
dialogue.translation_en: Three times a day after meals. Stay home and rest.
dialogue.translation_id: Tiga kali sehari setelah makan. Tetap di rumah dan istirahatlah.
